packets.description: The child TaskPackets in dependency order: a packet runs only after every packet listed before it.

phase.description: codegen for a source change, tests for a test file, docs for documentation, debug for a reproduction or diagnosis note, refactor for a change that keeps behaviour.

subtype.description: The stack adapter's hint for the task type, such as nest_controller, router_wiring, unit or readme; null when none applies.

module.description: A coarse grouping for the cost report, such as auth, billing or cross.

instruction.description: What the worker does, imperative and under about 300 tokens. Name the file it writes and what must be true of it.

inputs.description: The file slices the worker reads; it sees nothing else.

path.description: Relative to the project root. A stack guide keeps the absolute path it was given under.

content.description: An empty string to have the whole file read when the packet runs, or a slice. Always empty for the file this packet writes and for a file an earlier packet writes.

output_schema_json.description: The JSON Schema the worker's reply must match, encoded as a JSON string. For a packet that writes one file: {"type":"object","properties":{"content":{"type":"string"}},"required":["content"]}.

acceptance.description: Testable bullets the result must meet.

artifact_path.description: The one repo-relative path this packet writes.
